trailhead.label: Malga Pezié de Parù, the board’s start

cautions: The Locanda del Cantoniere is on the Dolomites road to Passo Giau: keep your dog close there.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Malga Pezié de Parù, the board’s start: Malga Pezié de Parù, la partenza indicata dalla scheda ufficiale
textIt.The Locanda del Cantoniere is on the Dol: La Locanda del Cantoniere è sulla strada delle Dolomiti verso il Passo Giau: lì tieni il cane vicino.
